verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs mention configurable guardrails that can be updated via prompts (sierra-docs-8) and hand-off rules you can experiment with (sierra-docs-29). Journeys and workflows can be defined as code or step-by-step logic (sierra-docs-1, sierra-docs-6), which implies topic-based escalation is buildable. However, nothing describes marking specific topics as human-only or guaranteeing the agent will not respond on them. Missing for 10: explicit topic-level human-only or escalation configuration, documented deterministic enforcement that the agent never answers restricted topics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
